decision: Natural implementation modules with explicit stable facade aliases; old saved pickle references continue loading through the original facade. New type provenance/pickles point to their actual owner.
reason: Artificially restoring module identity on every Pydantic class added repeated metadata and incomplete namespace/rebuild complications. No application requires equality of newly encoded Python pickle bytes. Preserve old decoding, exact field schemas, validator semantics, type shapes and full OpenAPI instead.
prototype_proof_observations: Original-validator pickle-byte comparison identified moved function provenance.
Literal per-class legacy module assignment made some Pydantic forward annotations incomplete before all facade exports loaded; prototype was not released or tested as qualified.
